_about: Editorial queue for the scheduled blog agent (docs/blog/AGENT.md). Work top to bottom. status: queued | in_review | published. Edit freely: reorder, add, remove or change angles.

queue.topic: AI agents vs chatbots vs RPA: what each one actually does in a business
queue.angle: Architecture-level comparison: memory, decisions, actions in systems, failure modes. Diagram-style table.

queue.topic: AI customer service agents: how they work end to end
queue.angle: From the first message to a resolved ticket: intent, context, knowledge, action, handoff, record. Technical but readable.

queue.topic: MCP, A2A and the agent protocol stack in 2026: what it means for a business, not a developer
queue.angle: Plain-language map of the protocols that let agents use tools and talk to each other, what is settled vs still moving, and what to ask a vendor. Cite the specs and recent releases.

queue.topic: Approval rules for AI agents: how to decide what an agent may do alone
queue.angle: Allowed / needs approval / never, thresholds, roles, a policy template readers can copy.

queue.topic: AI voice agents and the law in 2026: disclosure, caller ID and consent
queue.angle: FCC TCPA ruling on AI voices, newer proposals and state disclosure laws, AI caller ID efforts. Practical checklist for inbound vs outbound calls. Not legal advice; cite primary sources.

queue.topic: AI agents for internal operations: finance, HR and ops requests from Slack
queue.angle: Employees as users of the AI OS: invoice follow-up, onboarding, reporting, with the same rules as customer work.

queue.topic: AI agent certifications and audits: what buyers should ask for in 2026
queue.angle: New agent-specific standards (for example AIUC-1), SOC 2 and ISO 42001, what each covers and what it does not. Buyer checklist. Make no certification claims about Aurora.

queue.topic: AI voice agents on the phone: what changes when the customer is live on the line
queue.angle: Latency, interruptions, identity checks, handoff to a person mid-call, call recording consent.

queue.topic: What an AI agent audit log should record (and why it matters)
queue.angle: Fields to log, who reviews it, how it supports compliance and debugging. Reference frameworks such as NIST AI RMF.

queue.topic: Omnichannel AI: keeping one conversation across phone, SMS, WhatsApp and email
queue.angle: Identity resolution, shared history, channel-specific rules (consent, opt-out), what breaks without it.

queue.topic: Connecting an AI agent to your CRM: what it should read, write and never touch
queue.angle: Field-level permissions, deduplication, logging every write. HubSpot and Salesforce as examples, without claiming specific integrations beyond what the site states.

queue.topic: Automating invoice follow-up with an AI agent, step by step
queue.angle: Reminder cadence, tone, escalation, payment links, when finance must approve.

queue.topic: AI scheduling with Google Calendar and Outlook: how agents avoid double bookings
queue.angle: Free/busy, buffers, time zones, holds and confirmations, rescheduling rules.

queue.topic: How to measure the ROI of AI agents: the numbers to track before and after
queue.angle: Baseline, cost per handled request, time to first response, hours returned, conversion. Worksheet table.

queue.topic: Onboarding new hires with an AI agent: what can be set up before day one
queue.angle: Accounts, equipment requests, schedules, checklists, approvals from IT and HR.
